title: SearchKey::Body queries unscoped; Since/Before unimplemented
description:
In handle_nntp_search (lifecycle.rs:1125-1131), SearchKey::Subject and From map to field-scoped Tantivy queries (subject:"..." and from_header:"..."), but Body/Text map to bare value with no field prefix, causing the search to implicitly match all indexed fields (subject + from_header + body_text). This is undocumented and violates the principle of least surprise.

Additionally, SearchKey::Since and Before are parsed as enum variants but produce bare text queries—they're unimplemented placeholders that would silently fail if a client sends them.

Fix: (1) Document the implicit field list for Body/Text, or (2) Make Body explicitly query body_text field only, or (3) Implement Since/Before as date range queries on date_ts field (requires query_str to encode ranges). Also remove Since/Before from SearchKey enum if they won't be implemented in v1 (per design invariant #2: no moderation; retention is explicit).
